#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long power(long long x, long long y, long long p) {
    long long res = 1;
    x %= p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1)
            res = (res * x) % p;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long k = n * m;
    long long len = r - l + 1;
    const long long mod = 998244353;

    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << power(len, k, mod) << endl;
    } else {
        long long ans = (power(len, k, mod) + power(len % 2, k, mod)) % mod;
        ans = (ans * power(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod;
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
